title.en: Add existing ECS instances to a cluster

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口前，请仔细阅读[使用限制](~~86919~~)，确保待添加的ECS实例满足条件。
descriptions.en: Before you invoke this operation, read [Limits](~~86919~~) to make sure that the ECS instances to be added meet the requirements.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs attach-instances --cluster-id c106f377e16f34eb1808d6b9362c90000 --instances i-2zed0sswuau6o89b0000 --key-pair security-key --password Hello1234 --format-disk false --keep-instance-name false --is-edge-worker false --nodepool-id np615c0e0966124216a0412e10afe00000 --image-id aliyun_2_1903_x64_20G_alibase_20200529.vhd --cpu-policy none --user-data IyEvdXNyL2Jpbi9iYXNoCmVjaG8gIkhlbGxvIEFDSyEi --rds-instances rm-67yawhau0000 --runtime example-string --tags example-string --region cn-hangzhou
